import unittest
from types import MappingProxyType
from solution import migrate_schema


class ReviewProbe(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_readonly_mapping(self):
        source = MappingProxyType({'fields': {'blob': {'kind': 'old'}}})
        result = migrate_schema(source)
        self.assertEqual(result['fields']['blob']['kind'], 'upload')
        self.assertEqual(source['fields']['blob']['kind'], 'old')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import unittest

import solution


class BlobSchemaTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_blob_names_and_extensions(self):
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("Member_9", 0, "Photo.JPEG"),
                         "Member_9_0.jpeg")
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abc", 42, "archive"), "abc_42")
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abc", 42, ".profile"), "abc_42")
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abc", 42, "name."), "abc_42")
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abc", 42, "a.b.C"), "abc_42.c")

    def test_truncation_and_length_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abcdef", 12, "x.GZ", 10),
                         "abcd_12.gz")
        self.assertEqual(solution.make_blob_name("abcdef", 7, "x.txt", 7),
                         "a_7.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solution.make_blob_name("abcdef", 7, "x.txt", 6)

    def test_blob_name_validation(self):
        cases = [
            ("", 1, "x.txt", 80),
            ("a b", 1, "x.txt", 80),
            ("é", 1, "x.txt", 80),
            ("ok", True, "x.txt", 80),
            ("ok", -1, "x.txt", 80),
            ("ok", 1, "", 80),
            ("ok", 1, "a/b", 80),
            ("ok", 1, "a\\b", 80),
            ("ok", 1, "a\0b", 80),
            ("ok", 1, "x", True),
            ("ok", 1, "x", 0),
        ]
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    solution.make_blob_name(*args)

    def test_migration_is_deep_and_preserves_other_values(self):
        schema = {
            "name": "records",
            "metadata": {"owners": ["a"]},
            "fields": {
                "blob": {"kind": "old", "nested": [1]},
                "title": {"kind": "text", "options": [1, {"x": 2}]},
            },
        }
        migrated = solution.migrate_schema(schema)
        self.assertEqual(migrated["fields"]["blob"], {
            "kind": "upload",
            "optional": True,
            "max_length": 80,
            "namer": solution.make_blob_name,
        })
        self.assertIs(migrated["fields"]["blob"]["namer"], solution.make_blob_name)
        self.assertEqual(migrated["fields"]["title"], schema["fields"]["title"])
        self.assertIsNot(migrated["fields"], schema["fields"])
        self.assertIsNot(migrated["fields"]["title"], schema["fields"]["title"])
        self.assertIsNot(migrated["metadata"], schema["metadata"])
        migrated["metadata"]["owners"].append("b")
        migrated["fields"]["title"]["options"][1]["x"] = 9
        self.assertEqual(schema["metadata"]["owners"], ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(schema["fields"]["title"]["options"][1]["x"], 2)

    def test_migration_rejects_bad_structure(self):
        for value in (None, [], {}, {"fields": []}, {"fields": {}},
                      {"fields": {"other": {}}}):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    solution.migrate_schema(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
